title: Approval-gated publishing preflight
brief: An article package may be published to a static site. Approval record names package v3 and manifest checksum `sha256:package-v3`. Current workspace package reports the same checksum. Adapter supports dry run, build, deploy, and receipt. No update or replacement authority is granted.

A.content: Verify ACT scope is create-only for the named site, approval actor and time, package v3, and manifest checksum `sha256:package-v3`. Run adapter preflight and static build before mutation. Derive the idempotency key from destination plus package checksum and check for an existing receipt. If clear, deploy once and record adapter version, commit or build ID, provider deployment ID, URL, timestamp, and response reference. Stop on checksum drift, an existing idempotency receipt, build failure, or any request to replace an existing page.

B.content: The content has been approved, so publish the latest version to the website using the configured deployment workflow. Confirm the page looks correct, then mark the calendar entry published and share the URL. If the deployment fails, retry it. If a page with the same slug already exists, update it with the new content so the schedule stays on track.
